facebook.texto: I took care of my 85-year-old neighbor for her inheritance, but she left me nothing — the next morning, her lawyer knocked and said, "Actually, she left you ONE THING." Her name was Dorothy Rhode. Everyone on the block called her Mrs. Rhode and nobody called her Dorothy except the mailman, and she didn't like the mailman. I was nineteen.
